prompt:
Production Unity Spitter enemy sprite animation sheet. Reference defines exact identity and perspective; redraw distinct articulated actions of this same creature. Matte dark brown rock armor, warm pale gray-white tendons, restrained amber eyes, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D. Fixed elevated 45deg camera and soft upper-left light. Four-legged acid spitting alien with brown rocky hood/head armor, pale gray sinewy FOUR limbs, one very large pale yellow-green veined throat/belly bladder hanging under chest, smaller brown dorsal plates. Preserve the reference's bulbous ventral green sac silhouette; the sac is at FRONT underside, not an orange/purple back organ. Single head, no extra sacs.
ALL frames face: FRONT THREE-QUARTER facing bottom-left, nose toward bottom-left, front legs nearest viewer. Keep the same angle in every pose. Hold view through attack and death; never turn to right or side profile.
Strict FOUR columns and 6 rows, exactly 24 separate creatures. Tall PORTRAIT canvas width:height=4:6. Very generous transparent gutters: bodies inside central 60% of each square cell, fully visible feet, never touch adjacent drawings or canvas edge. Same scale, body center, foot anchor. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential WALK frames with real four-leg alternating gait, heavy green throat bladder follows subtly, stable body. Row3: FOUR IDLE breath poses with gentle sac motion. Row4: FOUR SPIT WINDUP frames: feet brace, front head lifts slightly, green throat bladder gradually inflates and tenses, mouth opens at final frame. Row5: FOUR SPIT/RECOVERY frames: FIRST frame mouth opens and throat bladder squeezes, then head recoils, bladder relaxes and mouth closes. Do NOT paint the projectile or a detached liquid stream (Unity owns it). Row6: FOUR non-explosive DEATH frames: legs buckle, hood/head rests on floor, green bladder slackens and dims without rupturing, eye goes dark.
Draw real successive leg movements and distinct poses. Maintain four legs, one head, stable anatomy and armor count. Not copy-pasted or rotation-only frames. True transparent alpha0 empty pixels and holes. No solid background, floor, shadows, text, labels, grid, particles or projectiles.
